purpose: Non-admission discovery of geospatial address, gazetteer, temporal-building, soil and self-hosted geocoding foundations for global CAT exposure linkage and map production.

entries.name: OpenAddresses worldwide authoritative address and parcel source index
entries.provider: OpenAddresses community and underlying national/local data providers
entries.spatial_scope: Global patchwork; uneven coverage and source completeness by jurisdiction
entries.temporal_scope: Rolling weekly pipeline; each country/state/source has its own vintage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Per-source address point records with street, house number, postcode and coordinate; catalog also locates parcel, building and road-centerline products
entries.note: Repository source definitions are CC0, but processed records retain each upstream government's original data license; do not treat the full batch as uniformly cleared. Preserve source ID, extraction vintage, coordinate precision and address-to-structure match ambiguity. Address points are not parcel valuation, building TIV or an independently verified structure footprint.

entries.name: GeoNames global place-name gazetteer and daily country extracts
entries.spatial_scope: Global place-name and administrative-feature coverage, uneven by region
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously revised; provider daily dumps and separate postal-code extracts
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Over 13 million named geographic features with WGS84 point coordinates, feature classes, alternate names, hierarchies and optional elevation/population
entries.note: Publisher advertises CC BY and commercial data use, but API service limits and exact extract/license version need documented review. This is mainly a WGS84 point gazetteer, not high-resolution polygon geometry, parcel geocoding truth or independent CAT event observations. Keep GeoNames IDs, feature codes, aliases, source date and ambiguous matches.

entries.name: Who's On First global gazetteer and administrative place hierarchies
entries.spatial_scope: Global administrative places, neighborhoods, postal-code and venue repositories with variable completeness
entries.temporal_scope: Version and revision tracked per individual GeoJSON record; source-specific vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Record-level GeoJSON geometry, stable 64-bit WOF identifiers, parent hierarchies, concordances and alternate names
entries.note: Not independent of GeoNames/OSM or other upstream gazetteers where concordances and geometry sources overlap. Inspect per-record source attribution, geometry accuracy, disputed or superseded boundaries, placetype and licenses before any commercial reuse. No insurer exposure or event-loss labels are implied.

entries.name: Microsoft TEMPO global temporal building density and height rasters
entries.spatial_scope: Global approximately 100 m grids for two public periods; 40 m quarterly data for five named locations
entries.temporal_scope: Global 2020 Q4 and 2023 Q4; five regions quarterly 2020 Q2 through 2025 Q2; repository update 2026-05-19
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Tile-index GeoPackage and two-band Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, building density fraction and height scaled to metres; ~100 m global/~40 m selected regions
entries.note: Distinct from the already admitted/discovered Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints polygon inventory. Repository explicitly licenses its COGs and GeoPackage tile index under CDLA Permissive 2.0, while code is MIT; still review selected asset/version. Both raster bands are model-derived from Planet imagery and training priors (including Overture/Google labels); they are not observed individual building heights, claims or independent holdout truth.

entries.name: OpenLandMap-soildb gridded predicted global soil properties
entries.spatial_scope: Global excluding deserts and permanent ice for documented 30 m model
entries.temporal_scope: Target 2000 through 2022+ with modeled five-year periods; publication/asset availability varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Approximately 30 m modelled soil texture, bulk density, carbon and pH by depth 0-30, 30-60 and 60-100 cm; predicted mean and uncertainty intervals
entries.note: Predictions use spatiotemporal machine learning from heterogeneous soil samples. Soil properties do not directly give landslide probability, river flood depth or site-level ground truth. Some underlying soil-sample catalogs have access restrictions or degraded coordinates. Check exact STAC asset, depth, unit, vintage, uncertainty and commercial licensing per layer before downloading.

entries.name: Pelias self-hosted multi-source geocoding workflow
entries.spatial_scope: Potentially global according to independently licensed imported source extracts
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained code and versioned input-data snapshots
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Forward/reverse geocoding API with importers for OpenAddresses, OpenStreetMap, GeoNames, Who's On First and custom CSV
entries.note: This is software (MIT) rather than a new location dataset. Its output depends on the imported records; each input data license, snapshot, quality profile and address privacy boundary must be reviewed separately. Record version, input-source fingerprints and candidate score; ambiguous matches must not become false building locations.

entries.name: Photon OpenStreetMap forward and reverse geocoder
entries.spatial_scope: According to imported OpenStreetMap coverage; potentially planet-wide
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained importer and optional OSM update feed
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OpenSearch-backed multilingual search-as-you-type, bounded-area and reverse-geocoding endpoints with OSM-based data
entries.note: Software is Apache-2.0 but its underlying OSM database retains ODbL obligations. The public Photon demo is limited and may throttle bulk workloads; use a self-hosted, version-pinned instance if justified. This is not independent of OSM, Nominatim or Overture OSM-derived building data.
